title: A backlog.py land run in the background writes its done row when it starts, so a failed landing still closes the window
goal: Found in the SP-s5fdczv7 review: kb-sprint run step 4 starts land in the background, and PostToolUse fires when the background command starts (the SP-s5fdczv7 orchestrator's spool has BG-tyuwiin7's done row at 16:13:58, 9 s into the prompt that launched land, minutes before the landing finished), so ql_capture.work_action stores done for a land or merge that has not run yet; a land that later stops at a step or is refused still closes the session's window, and the rework prompts until the next land count on no item. A land or merge whose tool_input has run_in_background true writes no done row at launch; the session's window of the item closes only by a row written once the landing succeeded (the item's done commit or a foreground land), and querylog.md and usage.md say which; the repro exits 0.

run: import os,sys,json,tempfile;from pathlib import Path;t=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA']=str(t/'d');os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT']=str(Path.cwd());sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_capture as q;q.capture({'hook_event_name':'PostToolUse','session_id':'s1','tool_name':'Bash','tool_input':{'command':'python3 _tools/backlog.py land ST-aaaaaaaa','run_in_background':True},'tool_response':{'stdout':'','stderr':'','backgroundTaskId':'b1'}});d=q.spool_dir();rows=[json.loads(l) for p in Path(d).glob('*.jsonl') for l in p.read_text().splitlines() if l.strip()];w=[r for r in rows if r.get('surface')=='work'];print('work rows at a background land launch:',[(r.get('item'),r.get('action')) for r in w]);sys.exit(1 if any(r.get('action')=='done' for r in w) else 0)

import os,sys,json,tempfile,shutil;from pathlib import Path;t=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA']=str(t/'d');os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT']=str(Path.cwd());sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_capture as q;q.capture({'hook_event_name':'PostToolUse','session_id':'s1','tool_name':'Bash','tool_input':{'command':'python3 _tools/backlog.py land ST-aaaaaaaa'},'tool_response':{'stdout':'landed ST-aaaaaaaa','stderr':''}});d=q.spool_dir();rows=[json.loads(l) for p in Path(d).glob('*.jsonl') for l in p.read_text().splitlines() if l.strip()];w=[r for r in rows if r.get('surface')=='work'];shutil.rmtree(t,ignore_errors=True);print('work rows at a foreground land:',[(r.get('item'),r.get('action')) for r in w]);sys.exit(0 if any((r.get('item'),r.get('action'))==('ST-aaaaaaaa','done') for r in w) else 1)

import os,sys,json,tempfile,shutil;from pathlib import Path;t=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA']=str(t/'d');os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT']=str(Path.cwd());sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_capture as q;c=t/'c';(c/'.git').mkdir(parents=True);(c/'.git'/'HEAD').write_text('ref: refs/heads/main\n');b=c/'kb'/'_self'/'backlog';b.mkdir(parents=True);f=b/'ST-aaaaaaaa.json';f.write_text(json.dumps({'id':'ST-aaaaaaaa','status':'doing'}));ev=lambda n,p,**k:q.capture(dict(hook_event_name=n,session_id='s1',prompt_id=p,cwd=str(c),**k));done=lambda:[r for p in Path(q.spool_dir()).glob('*.jsonl') for r in map(json.loads,p.read_text().splitlines()) if r.get('surface')=='work' and r.get('item')=='ST-aaaaaaaa' and r.get('action')=='done'];ev('PostToolUse','p1',tool_name='Bash',tool_input={'command':'python3 _tools/backlog.py land ST-aaaaaaaa','run_in_background':True},tool_response={'stdout':'','stderr':'','backgroundTaskId':'b1'});a=len(done());ev('Stop','p1');b1=len(done());f.write_text(json.dumps({'id':'ST-aaaaaaaa','status':'done'}));ev('Stop','p2');e=done();ev('Stop','p3');n=len(done());shutil.rmtree(t,ignore_errors=True);print('done rows: at launch',a,'while landing',b1,'after the landing',len(e),'at prompt',[r.get('prompt_id') for r in e],'later',n);sys.exit(0 if (a,b1,len(e),n)==(0,0,1,1) and e[0].get('prompt_id')=='p2' else 1)

gates.question: Which row closes a session's window of an item whose land ran in the background?
options: a done row the capture hook writes at a later prompt or Stop once the item file in the clone reads done
a done row from the Stop hook's background_tasks entry for the finished land
gates.recommendation: a done row the capture hook writes at a later prompt or Stop once the item file in the clone reads done
gates.answer: a done row the capture hook writes at a later prompt or Stop once the item file in the clone reads done

gates.question: How does capture remember a background land, merge or done until its item file reads done, and at which hooks does it look?
options: a done-pending work row at launch, settled at every later PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, UserPromptSubmit and Stop of the session
no row at launch; at Stop only, close every open window whose item file reads done
gates.recommendation: a done-pending work row at launch, settled at every later PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, UserPromptSubmit and Stop of the session
gates.answer: a done-pending work row at launch, settled at every later PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, UserPromptSubmit and Stop of the session

notes: Its check passes before the work: it pins that a foreground land still writes the item's done row, which the fix must keep; the repro is the failing proof.
